en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a bustling street scene beneath a hilltop fort with a lighthouse or signal tower. Market stalls with awnings line the street, people in traditional clothing walk or stand, and a cart is visible in the foreground. On top of the hill stands a fortified structure with walls and a tall lighthouse-like tower with antennas and a flag. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text reads "Alexandria - Fort Napoleon."
